description: Lists the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 print orders with their stage; use it when someone asks about their own orders. For one known order number use get_order_details. Inputs are optional: status and search narrow the list, insights adds totals. Returns order number, date, product, total and stage, newest first; with insights, spend and order totals. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "what is my order status", "my postcard orders", "how much did I spend this year".

insights.description: true adds order count, total spend, coins earned and top products.

status.description: Stage filter, e.g. delivered, shipped, in production, cancelled.

name: get_my_orders

data.description: The customer's orders: order number, date, product, total, stage; with insights, totals.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.

title: My 4OVER4 orders
